lessons: RESOLVED CARRY: the post-broadcast refund path is /services/ReverseTransaction, found in Pelecard's own WooCommerce plugin source (v1.5.3 changelog 'Refactored refund flow from DebitRegularType to ReverseTransaction'). It is NOT in the public /services builder, so a builder-only sweep will never find it. Live probe: JSON 501 auth error vs fabricated control 302->Http404. Lesson: read the vendor's own plugin SOURCE (plugins.svn.wordpress.org tags/<ver>), not just its changelog listing.

Match API (match-api.pelecard.biz) was mis-framed for three cycles as a 'modern payment REST surface' because /docs/index renders empty in curl. It is a Swashbuckle UI; the spec at /swagger/docs/v2 shows a settlement-reconciliation API. A JS-empty docs page means find the spec URL in the page source, not 'docs unavailable'.

v1.1.0 'never send a negative total, likely a second charge' was unsupported: Pelecard's own plugin refunded exactly that way (negative total + token on DebitRegularType) up to v1.5.2. A confident warning needs a source as much as a fact does.
v1.1.0 'no init parameter sets UniqueKey' was wrong: the plugin sends UserKey on init and validates with it as UniqueKey.

English 'credit' in Pelecard's error table is ambiguous; the Hebrew decides: עסקת זכות = refund/credit transaction (129/146/161/169), אשראי/קרדיט = credit-terms purchase (150/151/155/156). Always read the Hebrew column before grouping codes.
Bit limits in the skill were another PSP's (allpay) terms presented as Bit rules; now framed as illustrative. Pelecard publishes none.

Validator bugs found by running it: lookup conflated 'unreachable' with 'unassigned' (python.org macOS has no CA bundle -> every lookup failed silently), and 302 (debit succeeded) was reported as FAILED. Added certifi fallback, distinct exit codes, 30x handling, --self-test.
Judge 3 rounds, Expert 3 rounds, both PASS in round 3. Subagent channel failed silently on first dispatch of all four agents; recovered by asking each to write its verdict to a file.

DEFERRED (minor): refund invoice should be issued from the reversing terminal with the refund DebitTrxId (plugin does this); Consumer Protection Law 14-day start date and excluded goods; s.14I(e) cancellation info on invoices; parameter-casing value-add case; J5h semantics; what NewParamX/NewPaymentNo do; whether ReverseTransaction voids pre-broadcast. Rehearsal on a real test terminal would settle the ReverseTransaction unknowns.

Live probing beat documentation again. gateway21/gateway20 were found to serve an IDENTICAL API (three /PaymentGW endpoints only), disproving the 'gateway20 = sandbox' host model that v1.0.3 had only PARTIALLY softened: Step 2 hedged it while the Gotchas and Troubleshooting still hard-coded the wrong rule. Partial propagation of a prior fix is its own defect class.

Found Pelecard's live public request builder at gateway21.pelecard.biz/services (+ /Scripts/Services/Sandbox.js): 57 distinct service URLs, 54 under /services/. This resolved four separate 'the exact path lives in the Postman workspace / confirm with support' hedges that had survived three cycles.

The v1.0.3 refund contract was wrong: no PaymentGW refund endpoint exists (9 candidate paths 302 to Http404, same as a fabricated control). Replaced with the real void-vs-refund split (DeleteTran / DeleteIshur / EmvReversal before broadcast).

CARRY: the post-broadcast credit (zikuy) path is still NOT established. No /services endpoint is a card-not-present credit operation. The skill now says so explicitly and refuses to guess. Obtain it from Pelecard and document it next cycle. This is the single largest remaining gap.

error-codes.md had asserted the code table was 'not fully public, varies per acquirer, contact support, do not guess'. False: /services/GetErrorMessageEn and GetErrorMessageHe are CREDENTIAL-FREE. Swept 000-999 and shipped the real 254-row bilingual table. A confident negative needs its own positive search.
